annotations.title: Find a registrar by name or IANA ID

description: Which registrar is this? Search ICANN's accredited-registrar register by registrar name (or part of one, e.g. "GoDaddy", "Tucows", "namecheap") or by IANA registrar ID. Returns the matching registrars with their accreditation status and any ICANN enforcement action, each with the page and verbatim quote it was read from. Use this first when you have a name; use get_registrar when you already have the IANA ID. Screening one firm and would otherwise call several registers by hand? `screen_firm` at referencesource.org/mcp/screen answers this register and three others in one call.

query.description: Registrar name or part of one, or an IANA registrar ID. Case-insensitive substring match.

status.description: Optional: return only registrars with this accreditation status.

name: resolve_registrar

accreditation_status.description: Accredited, Terminated or Reserved — or null where neither page states one.

also_reported.description: Values for this record reported by a SECOND source, each with its own source_url and source_quote. Cite these to the page they name, never to the record's primary source.

iana_id.description: The IANA registrar ID, or null where the notice did not print one.

record_url.description: This record's own page on referencesource.org.

source_quote.description: Verbatim text from that page containing the value.

source_url.description: The page the value was read from.
